boundElement.zh-CN: 限制宽高的元素：'parent'、'window' 或一个 HTMLElement。
boundElement.en-US: Element that bounds the size: 'parent', 'window' or an HTMLElement.

boundsByDirection.zh-CN: 是否按拖动方向计算边界：为 true 时，从左侧或上侧手柄拖动，最大尺寸按元素固定的那一侧到限制元素对侧边缘的距离计算。
boundsByDirection.en-US: Whether bounds are computed by drag direction. When true, dragging from a left or top handle limits the size by the distance from the side that stays put to the opposite edge of the bound element.

defaultSize.zh-CN: 初始宽高，支持数字和字符串（px/vw/vh/%）；也是 `size` 未设置的轴的回退值。
defaultSize.en-US: Initial width and height, as a number or a string (px/vw/vh/%). It is also the fallback of an axis that `size` leaves unset.

enable.zh-CN: 可伸缩的方向，未设置为 false 的方向均可拖动；传入 false 则不渲染任何手柄。
enable.en-US: Directions that can be resized. A direction not set to false is enabled; false renders no handles.

grid.zh-CN: 调整大小时对齐的增量。

handle.zh-CN: 各启用方向手柄内容的 snippet，每个启用的方向渲染一次，参数 `{ direction }` 为该手柄的方向。
handle.en-US: Snippet for the content of the handle in each enabled direction. It renders once per enabled direction, with `{ direction }` set to that handle's direction.

handleClass.en-US: Class names of the handle in each direction.

handleStyle.zh-CN: 各方向手柄的样式，值为样式字符串。
handleStyle.en-US: Styles of the handle in each direction, as style strings.

handleWrapperClass.zh-CN: 包裹所有手柄的容器类名。
handleWrapperClass.en-US: Class name of the element that wraps all handles.

handleWrapperStyle.zh-CN: 包裹所有手柄的容器样式字符串。
handleWrapperStyle.en-US: Style string of the element that wraps all handles.

lockAspectRatio.zh-CN: 锁定横纵比：true 按初始宽高锁定，数字为宽高比。
lockAspectRatio.en-US: Locks the aspect ratio: true keeps the initial one, a number is the width to height ratio.

lockAspectRatioExtraHeight.zh-CN: 锁定横纵比时，不参与比例计算的额外高度（如内边距），单位为像素。
lockAspectRatioExtraHeight.en-US: Extra height in pixels (such as padding) left out of the ratio when the aspect ratio is locked.

lockAspectRatioExtraWidth.zh-CN: 锁定横纵比时，不参与比例计算的额外宽度（如内边距），单位为像素。
lockAspectRatioExtraWidth.en-US: Extra width in pixels (such as padding) left out of the ratio when the aspect ratio is locked.

onChange.zh-CN: 拖动或方向键改变尺寸时调用，参数为新尺寸、事件与方向。
onChange.en-US: Called when a drag or arrow key changes the size, with the new size, the event and the direction.

onResizeEnd.zh-CN: 结束伸缩时调用，参数为最终尺寸、事件与方向。
onResizeEnd.en-US: Called when resizing ends, with the final size, the event and the direction.

onResizeStart.zh-CN: 开始伸缩时调用，返回 false 取消本次伸缩。
onResizeStart.en-US: Called when resizing starts. Return false to cancel.

ratio.zh-CN: 拖动距离与实际尺寸变化的比例，可传 [宽, 高]。方向键每次固定改变 10px，不受 ratio 与 scale 影响。
ratio.en-US: Ratio of pointer movement to size change; pass [width, height] for per-axis ratios. Arrow keys always change the size by 10px, regardless of ratio and scale.

scale.zh-CN: 元素被外部缩放的比例，用于校正指针位移。
scale.en-US: Scale applied to the element from outside, used to correct the pointer movement.

size.zh-CN: 受控尺寸，按轴生效：未设置的轴仍跟随拖拽。单向 prop，不能 `bind:size`，在 `onChange` 里写回新尺寸。
size.en-US: Controlled size, applied per axis: an axis left unset follows the drag. A one-way prop that cannot be bound with `bind:size`: write the new size back in `onChange`.

snap.zh-CN: 调整大小时对齐的绝对像素值，x 与 y 均可省略。
snap.en-US: Absolute pixel values that resizing snaps to. Both x and y are optional.

snapGap.zh-CN: 移动到下一个对齐目标所需的最小间隙。
snapGap.en-US: Minimum gap required to move to the next snap target.

children.zh-CN: ResizeItem 与 ResizeHandler，子项挂载后自行向组注册。
children.en-US: ResizeItem and ResizeHandler children, which register themselves with the group once mounted.

direction.zh-CN: 组内的伸缩方向，horizontal 为左右排列，vertical 为上下排列。
direction.en-US: Resize direction within the group: horizontal lays items side by side, vertical stacks them.

defaultSize.zh-CN: 初始尺寸。字符串支持 %、px、vw、vh；纯数字或数字字符串表示按比例分配剩余空间。
defaultSize.en-US: Initial size. A string supports %, px, vw and vh; a number or numeric string takes a proportional share of the remaining space.

max.en-US: Maximum size (%, px, vw or vh).

min.en-US: Minimum size (%, px, vw or vh).

onChange.zh-CN: 拖动或方向键改变尺寸时调用，参数为新尺寸、事件与方向。
onChange.en-US: Called when a drag or arrow key changes the size, with the new size, the event and the direction.

onResizeEnd.zh-CN: 结束伸缩时调用，参数为最终尺寸、事件与方向。
onResizeEnd.en-US: Called when resizing ends, with the final size, the event and the direction.

onResizeStart.zh-CN: 开始伸缩时调用，手柄任一侧的项返回 false 即取消本次伸缩。
onResizeStart.en-US: Called when resizing starts. If the item on either side of the handler returns false, the resize is cancelled.
